t: Nextdoor and More: The Good, Bad and Ugly of Neighborhood Social Networks | HowStuffWorks
s: March 8, 2023 - And when an elderly couple's basement flooded in Columbus, Ohio, in 2014, they posted urgent requests for assistance on Facebook, Twitter and the neighborhood-based site Nextdoor. But it was the Nextdoor connections who actually showed up. ... "It was like living in an Amish community, and somebody had rung a bell, 'cause people just came out of the woodwork to help," the grateful husband told The Verge. Stories like these explain the draw of locality-based online social networks.
